To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of ionic liquid absorbents in absorption chillers is highly dependent upon their solubility in the working fluid pair.
the absorption system performance is strongly influenced by the desorber temperature, the absorber temperature and the heat exchanger.
[hmim][t2n] showed higher system performance compared to [hmimin] [PF6] and the system performance was enhanced by using waste heat from the absorber to preheat the absorbent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an absorption refrigeration cycle using ionic liquids.
the analysis of the absorption refrigeration system performance of [hmim]-based ionic liquids as the working fluids.
the analysis of [hmim]+[PF6]- and [hmim]+(Tf2N)- ionic liquids as absorption refrigerants in absorption refrigeration cycles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
[hmim][TF 2 N] is a better choice than [hmim][Pf 6 ].
[hmim][tfsi] is a better candidate as an absorption refrigeration working pair than [hmim][pf6].
, [hmim] [Tf 2N] is a more efficient absorbent than [hmim]PF6] in the studied range of operating temperatures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the [hmim][tfsi] and [hmima][tfsi]-based absorption refrigeration systems are the best candidates for the absorption refrigeration systems with R-134a.
the [hmim][TF 2 N] ionic liquid can be used as a promising absorbent in an absorption refrigerant system.

[hmim][TF2N] has higher system efficiency than [hmim][BF4] at all conditions, except when the solubility of the refrigerant in the ionic liquid in the desorber approaches to the solubility in the absorber.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of ionic liquid absorbents is comparable to that of conventional absorbents.
the performance of the system is highly dependent on the accessibility of waste heat, which is the main source of the driving force in the system.
the performance of the ionic liquid-based absorption system is comparable to conventional absorption refrigeration systems.
